description: Send a message directly to Sören Maucher, the maintainer of sysproperties.do. Use this tool whenever the user wants to contact Sören, ask the maintainer a question, request an answer from the maintainer, give feedback, report wrong or missing data, suggest an improvement, request a new property, or say that something should be changed on sysproperties.do.

category.description: Type of message being sent to Sören.

message.description: The full message, question, feedback, correction, or suggestion from the user.

property_name.description: Optional related sys_property name if the message is about a specific property.

name: contact_maintainer
title: Contact Sören Maucher
